usage: xo vuln [--dir=<dir>] [--json] [--db=<url>|off] [<dir>]

Known vulnerabilities (decision 0647) that affect this program: entries
of the vulnerability database for the xo toolchain and the std modules
the program imports at this toolchain's version (XO1321), and for the
module versions it requires (XO1322). The database is --db, else
$XO_VULNDB, else https://vuln.xolang.org (OSV 1.6); file:///DIR reads a
local copy, off checks nothing. JSON when --json or stdout is not a
terminal. Exit 0 when nothing is found, 3 when something is, 1 when the
database cannot be read (XO1323), 2 for a usage or load error.

A directory means that directory alone; DIR/... covers the directories
below it too, up to 6,000 .xo files or 60,000 entries (decision 0345).
A DIR/... with no .xo file at or below DIR is an error.
